title: Procedure File: 2026/0068(COD) | Legislative Observatory | European Parliament

triage.reason: The procedure file shows recent parliamentary activity on the Industrial Accelerator Act (committee amendments tabled 13 and 19 October 2026 and an ENVI committee opinion of 22 October 2026), a concrete legislative step within the last 60 days.

draft.summary: Amendments to the committee draft report on the Industrial Accelerator Act proposal (2026/0068(COD)) were tabled in committee on 19 October 2026 (PE796.455). A committee opinion from ENVI (PE789.106) on the proposal is recorded with the date 22 October 2026.
draft.source_quote: Amendments tabled in committee PE796.455 19/10/2026 Committee opinion ENVI PE789.106 22/10/2026
draft.interpretation: The file is still at committee stage, with amendments being tabled and an indicative first-reading plenary date set for 14 December 2026. Plastics appears among the subject classifications, but these committee documents give no detail on provisions affecting converters or recyclers.
